caseNameFull: Williams v. Zbaraz Quern, Director, Department of Public Aid of Illinois v. Zbaraz and United States v. Zbaraz

opinions.text: Appeals from D. C. N. D. Ill. Motions of Legal Defense Fund for Unborn Children and Cora McRae et al. for leave to file briefs as amici curiae denied. Motion of Alan Ernest for appointment as counsel for children unborn and born alive denied. Further consideration of question of jurisdiction postponed to hearing of cases on the merits. Cases consolidated and a total of one and one-half hours allotted for oral argument. Reported below: 469 F. Supp. 1212.
